Occurrences.Kwic: 蹋蹋倒，起來便道：『百千法門、無量玅義，只向一毫頭上識得根源去。』臨濟喫黃檗三頓痛棒，便道：『元來佛法無多子。』你道者三箇老古錐當時如何做工夫？德山、馬祖又如何考較？須知此事無汝用心處、無汝湊泊處，你纔上蒲團，牚眉努目，惺惺地思量卜度時，早已蹉過了也。直饒你不思量、不擬議，未免坐在黑山鬼窟裏。古人不得已作死馬醫，向第二義門與你和泥合水，說道『喚作竹篦則觸、不喚作竹篦則背，不得有語、不得無語。』與麼稱提，已是八字打開了也。爭奈根性遲鈍，不能領略，遂將此話蘊在八識田中，時刻追究，謂之看話頭做工夫。宋時有箇大慧禪師，常握竹篦鉗鎚學者，一時宗風大振，不減馬祖。嗣後相襲成風，皆以看話頭為參禪。凡學者一進門來，師家亦不管青黃

Senses.Explanation: The dead-horse cure of the Chan records: the master concedes the case is past saving and treats it anyway — speech as the last kindness, or a kindness refused. Yunfeng Wenyue rules the sickness past the poultice beyond prescribing and does the dead-horse cure anyway, asking the assembly whether there is still blood under their skin, Chaozong Tongren finds that on close inspection even the ancients' head-straight tail-straight awakenings remain dead-horse cures turned fixed things still wanting the Caoshan gate's beating, Ying'an Tanhua sets the good doctor's gate where the patients only grow worse and charges Bao'en with the cure anyway, unable to dodge the lacquer-bucket brigade, and Yongjue Yuanxian concedes he merely does the dead-horse cure in teaching people to leave mind-consciousness and pierce through to the inherent light, denying all the while that it dulls the brothers. Jiqi Hongchu grants that Lingyan cannot help but do the dead-horse cure and rules a whole life of pilgrimage just post-shaking in the mud and watching others eat, Tianran Hanshi forbids the cure outright — the second visit of Baizhang and the clapped palms of Yantou stand beyond it — Pinjixiang Zhixiang calls his own hedge-tearing wall-patching the unavoidable cure and blesses the one who would overturn the seat and shout the assembly away, and Guxue Zhenzhe rules the ancients had no choice either: mud and water at the second-meaning gate, the neither-touch-nor-turn watchword already eight characters flung open.
